name: Reasoning as Retrieval Benchmark (RAR-b)
description: RAR-b is a holistic suite of tasks and settings designed to evaluate the reasoning abilities stored in retriever models by transforming reasoning tasks into retrieval tasks. It aims to assess how well retriever models can assist large language models in reasoning-intensive tasks under the Retrieval-augmented Generation paradigm.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the RAG/retrieval community that is cited in work on retrieval-augmented reasoning, but it is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on evaluating reasoning abilities in retriever models; highlights a retriever-LLM behavioral gap; includes fine-tuning of re-ranker models to improve performance.
